raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pyuvdata
  version: "3.2.8"
  sha256: 34f9f134d77a374d5c0c1b14a3e75790a5eaa0d7ae9cfac6b84003d8a70a7343

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ${{ sha256 }}

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - ${{ match(python, "<=3.10") }}
  script:
    env:
      CYTHON_FORCE_REGEN: "1"
    content: |
      ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed --no-cache-dir -vvv

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cython
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: numba
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: numpy
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - astropy-base >=6.0
    - cython >=3.0
    - docstring_parser >=0.15
    - h5py >=3.7
    - numba >=0.57.0
    - numpy  # pyuvdata needs >=1.23
    - pip
    - pyerfa >=2.0.1.1
    - python
    - pyyaml >=5.4.1
    - scipy >=1.9
    - setuptools >=64
    - setuptools_scm >=8.1
  run:
    - astropy-base >=6.0
    - docstring_parser >=0.15
    - h5py >=3.7
    - numba >=0.57.0
    - pyerfa >=2.0.1.1
    - python
    - pyyaml >=5.4.1
    - scipy >=1.9
    - setuptools_scm >=8.1
  run_constraints:
    - astropy-healpix >=1.0.2
    - astroquery >=0.4.4
    - hdf5plugin >=3.3.1
    - python-casacore >=3.5.2

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pyuvdata
      pip_check: false
  - files:
      source: 
        - tests
    requirements:
      run:
        - git
        - astropy-healpix >=1.0.2
        - astroquery >=0.4.4
        - hdf5plugin >=3.3.1
        - cython >=3.0
        - matplotlib >=3.7
        - pooch >=1.8
        - pytest <9.1
        - pytest-cases >=3.9.1
        - pytest-xdist
        - if: not win
          then:
            - python-casacore >=3.5.2
    script:
      - pytest -vv -s tests

about:
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: an interface for astronomical interferometeric datasets in python
  homepage: https://github.com/RadioAstronomySoftwareGroup/pyuvdata
  repository: https://github.com/RadioAstronomySoftwareGroup/pyuvdata
  documentation: https://pyuvdata.readthedocs.io

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - plaplant
    - bhazelton
    - pkgw
